method.manual: Visible controls only, with fixed reading, orientation, typing, and result-inspection pauses. Canvas geometry used a visible drag and was corrected after reading the resulting area.
method.webmcp: Registered public WebMCP tools only, plus the same visible human approval controls required by Reviewed mode.
method.timingBoundary: Task start after the page was loaded through authoritative visible completion. WebMCP time includes tool execution, staged-preview rendering, and human approval pauses, but excludes language-model inference and prompt composition.
method.interactionDefinition: One click, field entry, selection, drag, approval, or WebMCP tool call. Passive waits are timed but not counted as interactions.
method.scopeWarning: This is one controlled local comparison, not a population usability study or a claim about every device, browser, model, or user.

tasks.brief: Find Rotary evaporator flask set and reveal its exact physical location.

manual.outcome: Found the canonical inventory record and displayed North reagent cabinet / Drawer 02.

webmcp.outcome: Found and focused the same canonical record and storage path.

tasks.brief: Add 4 bottles of Benchmark buffer solution to DEMO-01 / North reagent cabinet / Drawer 01.

manual.outcome: Created the item directly at Drawer 01 through the Storage workspace.

webmcp.outcome: Resolved the canonical Drawer 01 ID, staged one record, and saved it only after visible approval.

tasks.brief: Locate Nitrile gloves, M and Reference standards and advance through both locations.

manual.outcome: Searched and focused each item separately, reading both physical address trails.

webmcp.outcome: Matched both canonical records and created a persistent Next/Previous collection guide without changing stock.

comparison.note: WebMCP was 0.538 seconds slower but produced a resumable, timestamped collection guide rather than two independent searches.

tasks.brief: Check whether DEMO-01 has current deterministic planning issues.

manual.outcome: Opened Issues and read 0 placement warnings.

webmcp.outcome: Returned ready status, zero issues, five named deterministic checks, room metrics, and bounded non-certification language.

comparison.note: WebMCP was 0.127 seconds slower and returned substantially more structured evidence.

tasks.brief: Create Benchmark Office, code B812, on Floor 8 with an exact 8 m by 4 m closed room shell.

manual.outcome: The first visible drag produced 36.80 m2; Undo and a second grid-aligned drag produced the required 32.00 m2 shell.

webmcp.outcome: Created a blank Floor 8 room and an exact 32.00 m2 shell after separate room-identity and blueprint approvals.

comparison.note: Reviewed WebMCP was slower because it rendered a deterministic staged preview and preserved two explicit human approval boundaries.

warnings: Existing Three.js THREE.Clock deprecation warning; no task interruption
